notes.purpose: Where the sync notice sits: the first card of Home, below the scope switch.

elements.name: Saved-work card
elements.shows: "N records saved on this device" and the connection line

states.when: The last upload did not complete

states.shows: Quiet row "All records uploaded" at the bottom of Home, not the top

elements.logic: The queue is device-wide: not scoped to the section or unit. A pending queue puts the card first; an empty one moves it to the bottom.

issues: Treatment sync from the old design (the all-treatments list) has no entry here.

notes.purpose: Shows what is saved on the phone and not yet sent, and lets the worker upload it.

elements.name: Upload button and message
elements.shows: Upload 3 records · No connection · check Wi-Fi or mobile signal

states.when: No connection (default; "Connection preview" select outside the phone)
states.shows: "3 records waiting to upload", button "Upload 3 records"; pressing it reports "Still no connection. All 3 records remain on this device."
"Upload did not complete. Your records are still on this device. Try again." with "Retry upload"
"Everything is uploaded", "There are no records waiting on this device.", button "Done"

elements.rule: Only a successful upload clears the queue; a failure keeps every record. The drawer separates records saved on this device from records uploaded for the team.

elements.name: Record row
elements.logic: Task, animal, place and save time of a queued record. Three fictional samples; nothing the other screens do feeds this queue.

issues: The offline queue is entirely simulated: records made in the other prototypes never appear here.
unclear: where the old Figma data-sync list and detail (数据同步) fit relative to this drawer.

notes.purpose: Detail by pig or by treatment: waiting, syncing, conflict, and empty.
issues: Old design only: the per-pig and per-treatment detail with conflict and empty states is not built; the drawer lists a flat queue.

notes.purpose: The saved-work drawer after a successful upload.

elements.name: Upload button and message
elements.shows: "Everything is uploaded" · "There are no records waiting on this device." · Done

states.when: About 0.9 s after Upload is pressed

states.shows: Queue emptied, "Upload complete." status, button becomes Done

elements.rule: Only a successful upload clears the queue; Home then shows the quiet "All records uploaded" row.

notes.purpose: The saved-work drawer after an upload attempt with no connection.

elements.name: Failure message
elements.shows: "Still no connection. All 3 records remain on this device." and the button changes to Retry upload

states.when: Connected but the upload does not complete (Connection preview: failed)
states.shows: "Upload did not complete. Your records are still on this device. Try again." with "Retry upload"

elements.rule: A failure keeps every record in the queue and the user can retry at once.
